audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Gwen five of seven rows against a 49.37% win rate, while the prose says 'concede the level' at 2 and 'levels 2-3 are his only real kill window'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Tahm Kench/Skill/Tahm Kench/Gwen/Gwen/Skill; the mirror audit (audits/top/tahmkench__gwen.json) reports the same chart and the same full-vs-content disagreement from the other side.
audit.corrected: Chart realigned to the packet in both layers; difficulty 4/10 raised to 5/10 to match an even win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text and Abyssal Dive was called 'his escape + shield'.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive is a 21/20/19/18/17s dive-and-knockup engage from 1000-1200 range. The shield is Thick Skin (E) on a 3s cooldown, converting stored damage.
audit.corrected: Abyssal Dive is now correctly an engage with a punishable 17-21s window; Thick Skin is named as the shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer attributes Devour to W in four places ('lash-into-W-devour', 'his W devour', 'W can swallow your burst', 'Use W to swallow'). Devour is his R.
audit.why: Riot: W is Abyssal Dive ('Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up'); R is Devour ('Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds'). Riot on An Acquired Taste: 'At three stacks, he can use Devour on an enemy champion', and Tongue Lash 'If the champion already has 3 stacks... they are stunned and the stacks are consumed'. So the stack count, not a cooldown, gates both his stun and his Devour — and Devour needs a target it can reach, which Hallowed Mist denies from outside.
audit.corrected: Devour reassigned to R throughout; the three-stack gate written into the phase whys, dos/donts and the interactions row.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers, and the wrong ability was tracked.
audit.why: Tongue Lash 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s, Abyssal Dive 17-21s, Thick Skin 3s, Devour has no cooldown of its own — it is gated on stacks.
audit.corrected: All written in; the stack count replaces the imaginary Devour cooldown.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Abyssal Dive's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Tahm Kench carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His escape + shield. Out-DPS when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive (17-21s): a knockup engage from over 1000, not an escape — punish the miss. - Thick Skin (3s): his shield, converted from stored damage. - Tongue Lash stuns on the third stack. - Needlework: kill windows only.

edits.after: His Tongue Lash stacks An Acquired Taste, and the third stack stuns; if he marks you and walks up, that stun unlocks Devour (R) and bursts you before you have a second point in Snip Snip! or any mist to hide behind.

edits.before: Level 6 is your flip. Needlework's slow plus a maxed Q-W means you can drop Hallowed Mist exactly as he Tongue-Lashes in, go untargetable while his devour and follow-up whiff, then R-slow him so he can't tongue away while you snip the giant bar down. Your passive heals off every snip that lands on him, so the more HP he stacks the more you out-sustain the trade. Keep anti-heal up: his grey-health regen is the only thing keeping these trades even instead of yours, and his W devour is the one button that can still cancel your burst mid-combo.
edits.after: Level 6 is your flip. Needlework's slow plus a maxed Q-W means you can drop Hallowed Mist exactly as he Tongue-Lashes in, go untargetable while the stun and his follow-up whiff, then R-slow him so he can't tongue away while you snip the giant bar down. Your passive heals off every snip that lands on him, so the more HP he stacks the more you out-sustain the trade. Keep anti-heal up: Thick Skin's stored-damage shield, off a 3-second cooldown, is the only thing keeping these trades even instead of yours, and Devour (R) is the one button that still cancels your burst.

edits.before: This stays a grind, not a stomp. Your percent-max-HP snips and true-damage center snip are exactly what punish a Tahm who stacks HP, and a clean mist duel shreds him, but his grey-health passive regenerates between every trade and his W can swallow your committed damage in one cast, so if you can't close one mist window cleanly he just resets. Burst him inside a single Hallowed Mist with anti-heal up; if he devours away or roams with R, don't chase a drain-tank across the map, take the tower and the tempo and let your scaling do the rest.
